title: Introduce percentile telemetry enrichment and per-slice dashboards with synthetic workload tagging
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: extend our telemetry pipeline and dashboards to provide reliable p95/p99 visibility sliced by route, model variant, and region, including synthetic-workload tagging so we can separate production traffic from synthetic/regression load tests. This ticket covers the pipeline enrichment, aggregation semantics, retention strategy, dashboard surface, and the regression detection alert rules that run on top of the new metrics.

Context: the platform currently surface token/sec and top-level latency histograms but lacks a stable, time-bucketed p95/p99 emitter per (route, model, region) slice and no reliable way to filter synthetics. As a result, regressions from canaries and CI load tests sometimes pollute customer SLIs and we lack fast attribution for p95/p99 spikes.

Scope:
- Emiters: add a percentile-slice emitter in the quantile aggregation tier that computes p50/p90/p95/p99 every 10s and writes to the telemetry topic with canonical tags: route, model, model_variant, region, deployment_id, workload_label (production|synthetic), seq_len_bucket.
- Synthetic tagging: wire the load testing harness and synthetic clients to set workload_label header; provide a fallback deterministic sampler that tags internal test origins.
- Storage/rollup: retention of 90 days at 10s granularity for recent 7 days, hourly rollups thereafter.
- Dashboards: new dashboard group that allows multi-axis panels for p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and request rate; prebuilt filters for route/model/region and synthetic toggles; per-slice comparison view.
- Regression detection: stream-based detector that compares latest p95/p99 against 7-day rolling baseline and opens an incident or ticket when regression > 30% absolute or >2x relative and sustained >5 minutes.
- Backwards compatibility: emitter tags must be optional (no schema changes for older consumers) and backwards-compatible consumer logic preserved.

Out-of-scope: long-term percentile decomposition by kernel type and per-GPU metrics (follow-up ticket).
acceptance_criteria: p95 and p99 metrics emitted every 10s into telemetry topic with tags: route, model, model_variant, region, deployment_id, workload_label, seq_len_bucket
Dashboards: new 'Percentile Slices' dashboard group accessible in Console with prebuilt filters and a comparison panel for two slices
Synthetic traffic can be toggled on/off in dashboards and is excluded from production SLO calculations by default
Regression detector flags sustained p95/p99 regressions according to defined thresholds and creates automated alerts in PagerDuty and a Linear ticket when appropriate
Telemetry retention and rollup behavior matches 10s recent / 1h rollups and query performance is within SLO for dashboard loads (< 2s for single-slice 1h range)
implementation_notes: Add PercentileEmitter to quantile-aggregator service; use t-digest for memory efficiency on 10s windows
Emit payloads to telemetry.kafka.percentiles topic with Avro schema version 3 (add optional fields workload_label and seq_len_bucket)
Instrument load-test client libs (inferbench and regression harness) to set 'X-Workload-Label: synthetic' header; server-side middleware will map to workload_label tag
Enhance telemetry query layer to expose 'exclude_synthetic=true' parameter and optimize pre-aggregated keys for (route, model, region)
Build Grafana/Console panels using new percentile endpoints and reuse existing token/sec panels for cross-correlation
test_plan: Unit tests for PercentileEmitter: verify correct tag propagation, t-digest compression, and Avro schema compatibility
Integration: run regression harness with synthetic tagging and assert dashboard 'synthetic toggle' hides the synthetic spike; compare token/sec vs p95 curves
Load test emitter at 10k slices/second equivalent and validate Kafka partitioning and consumer throughput under peak load
Canary rollout: enable emitter in staging, validate 24h of telemetry, then enable in canary region (us-west-2) for 72h before global rollout
Failover tests: ensure missing workload_label defaults to 'production' only in the emitter for compatibility, and that synthetic sampler marks internal CI IPs
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): deploy PercentileEmitter behind feature-flag, collect 48h of metrics, verify queries and dashboard rendering
Phase 2 (canary): enable in us-west-2 production for low-traffic routes (5% traffic) for 72h; monitor Kafka lag and dashboard query latency
Phase 3 (regional ramp): gradually enable per region over 48h windows, monitor cost/QPS and SLOs
Phase 4 (global): flip feature flag for all routes and disable synthetic baseline injection once stable
monitoring_alerts: Telemetry consumer lag > 5 minutes for any percentile topic partition
Dashboard query latency > 2s (single-slice 1h range) for > 10% of requests over 15m
Regression detector: sustained p95 > baseline * 2 OR absolute increase > 30% for > 5 minutes
High cardinality explosion: unique (route,model,region) slices tracked grows > 2x expected backlog for 1h
